# Internal URLs
Most FS/bash tools resolve these; path selectors: `read` docs.
- `agent://<id>`: latest completed output (status + progress while unpublished); nested IDs dotted, `/key/index` JSON path; write = message.
- `history://<id>`: read-only condensed transcript; bare lists registered and retained on-disk agents, not persisted unregistered top-level sessions. It keeps the user, assistant and developer text of the agent's current context; turns a compaction removed show only as a one-line summary, peer messages and other notices as one-line previews, job results as their labels, and each tool call as one line with its main argument and the result's status and line count (for an error, also its first line), not its output; thinking and most hidden messages are left out. `read` and `grep` see only this text, so a miss there does not mean something never happened. A saved session's JSONL keeps every entry, tool results included: a root session's is `<timestamp>_<sessionId>.jsonl` (by default under `~/.omp/agent/sessions/`, or under the session directory that `--session-dir`, `PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR` or the RPC `open_session` command sets), and its subagents' are `<id>.jsonl` files under that path without the `.jsonl`. An unsaved session (`--no-session`, or an SDK in-memory session) writes no root JSONL and keeps its subagents' files only in a temporary directory, so it may have no full record.
- `artifact://<id>`: spilled output; page :N-M or :raw:N-M.
- `local://<name>.md`: shared artifact.
- `proc://`: jobs, agents, and services; `proc://<id>` status/output; write sends stdin to services only (empty = Enter); `proc://<id>/kill` cancels/stops jobs, agents, and services, omit `content`; `proc://<id>/mode`: `persist`|`session`|`detached` (services only); start long-lived work as a named service when it needs stdin or lifetime controls; `proc://<id>/streams` lists a bash job's pipes, `proc://<id>/streams/<n>` reads what crossed pipe `n` so far (live under `| tail`/`| grep`; never rerun to see it); completed jobs evicted (process-local); parked agents/missing job ≠ lost: check `agent://<id>`, `history://<id>`.
- `ssh://host/<path>`: remote UTF-8 file/dir (max 1 MiB) for read/write/grep; bare lists hosts. `/~/path` and `/~` use the connected remote account's HOME, not local HOME; `/~user` is unsupported, `/%7E/` is literal. Encode `:` `?` `#` as %3A %3F %23. Needs verified POSIX shell; else bash remote SSH or sshfs.
- `mcp://<uri>`: MCP resource.
- `omp://`: harness docs, AVOID unless asked.
